headline: 🔴 WSO2 CVE-2026-5430 KEV-listed under live attack, 🤑 Bitget confirms $351.6M wallet theft, 🎯 SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 re-rated and exploited, ⚔️ Ransomware joins TeamCity exploitation, 🐳 Carbonato AI-agent botnet hijacks Docker hosts, 🔑 RSA HSM signature forgery without key extraction
summary: CISA's KEV clock on the exploited WSO2 JWT bypass and ransomware crews joining TeamCity exploitation drive the patching agenda, while Bitget's $351.6M signing-service theft and a hash-gated Terraform supply chain campaign widen the front beyond CVE churn.
